input.objective: Identifique todos os componentes de UI visíveis na interface.

rationale: Scanning image from top to bottom, left to right to identify all UI components. Starting with the blue square in the top-left corner.

message.reasoning:
Okay, let's tackle this problem. The user wants me to analyze the provided image and return a JSON with all visible UI components. The image is 1320x642 pixels, and I need to scan it from top to bottom, left to right, making sure not to miss any elements, even small ones like icons or badges.

First, I'll start by looking at the top part of the image. There's a blue square in the top-left corner. Since it's a solid color without any text or icons, it might be a background element or a button. But since there's no text or interactive elements, maybe it's just a decorative box. I'll note it as a "div" with a blue background.

Next, moving to the right of that blue square, there's a navigation bar. It has a menu icon (three horizontal lines) and a search icon. These are probably buttons. The menu icon is a hamburger menu, so I'll label it as a "button" with a hamburger icon. The search icon is a magnifying glass, so another button with a search icon. Both are interactive, so they should be separate elements.

Below the navigation bar, there's a section with a user profile picture and a name. The profile picture is a circle with a user image, so that's an "image" element. The name next to it is text, so a "text" element. Both are part of the user profile section.

Further down, there's a list of items. Each item has a thumbnail image on the left, a title, and a description. The thumbnail is an "image" element. The title and description are "text" elements. Each list item should be a separate entry in the JSON array.

There's also a button labeled "Add New" below the list. That's another button element with the text "Add New". It's interactive, so it needs to be included.

In the bottom-right corner, there's a small badge with the number "5". Badges are usually for notifications or counts, so this is a "badge" element with the text "5".

I need to make sure I didn't miss any elements. Let me check again. The blue square, navigation bar with two buttons, user profile with image and text, list items with image, title, description, the "Add New" button, and the badge. That seems to cover all visible components. Each element's coordinates should be within the image's bounds, so I'll calculate their positions based on the image dimensions. For example, the blue square is at (0,0) with width and height matching its size. The navigation bar starts after the blue square, so x would be the width of the blue square, and so on for each element.

I should also ensure that each element's type is correctly identified. For instance, buttons have actions like onClick, inputs have onChange, etc. Since the image doesn't show any text inputs or checkboxes, those might not be present. The user profile image is static, so it's just an image element. The list items are part of a table or list structure, so each row would be a separate element.

Finally, I'll structure the JSON array with each element's id, type, coordinates, and meta information. Making sure all coordinates are integers and within the image's resolution. No overlapping elements, and each is listed separately even if they're part of a group like the list items.
